biography.value: Stormcalls fight from altitude, opening with Wind Blade against the closest threat, then spending a second action on Lightning Arc against anything at range, and using a third action to reposition while maintaining Momentum Defense. The MAP on that third action is real but the Stormcall accepts it — staying in motion matters more than clean dice. Agil 7 means they act before most of what they face. A summoner who gives a Stormcall a target designation and stays out of the way will find it requires little management.

system.attacksNotes:
Wind Blade [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (6 + 3 Str); target pushed 10 feet.
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up); target pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn from a concentrated wind impact.

Lightning Arc [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 3), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 lightning damage (7 + 5 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 12 lightning damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Dazed condition until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 12 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Dazed + Stunned until end of their next turn.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Momentum Defense: While the Stormcall has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Storm Body: Grapple attempts add 1 to both dice. If successfully grappled, the Stormcall makes a Fortitude [Easy] save at the start of its turn to break free automatically.
